extracted.name: Thai noodle soup with salmon
extracted.description: Get a dose of omega-3 with this family-friendly Thai-style noodle soup with salmon. It uses just five ingredients and takes only 30 minutes to make
instruction_lines: Heat the grill to high. Put the salmon on a baking tray, skin-side down, and grill for 8-10 mins until cooked through. Put the noodles in a heatproof bowl and pour over boiled water from the kettle. Leave for 5 mins.

Heat the curry paste in a pan for 1 min, then add the coconut milk and 400ml water. Season and bring to the boil. Drain the noodles and add to the pan with the pak choi. Heat through for 1 min, then transfer to bowls and top with the salmon.
